db_note: DEPLOYED 2026-09-22 17:13. The two stacked config bugs (env_prefix MEMCORE_ vs MNEM_, and derived paths frozen at class-creation time) are fixed AND live: the container now reads and writes /data, the volume holds the data, /root/.memcore no longer exists, and a restart keeps all 120 memories. The README tar backup finally captures something (619KB).
key_destruction_note: CRITICAL, fixed 2026-09-22. KeyManager.load_or_create branched on `st_size > 100`, so a raw 32-byte unprotected key never matched the load path and was OVERWRITTEN with a fresh key on every open. It fired on this container at 23:40:47 UTC 2026-09-21 during an audit `docker exec`. The REST process kept working from its in-memory key while its own DB became undecryptable on disk. Data fully recovered (only content+metadata are encrypted; id/tier/timestamp/forgetting_json/entities_json/embedding are plaintext columns) into db_recovered. Deploy from db_recovered, NOT from the container's writable layer. FIXED AND DEPLOYED 2026-09-22 17:13: the running image no longer rotates the key, verified by comparing master.key checksums across a restart. Exposure at its peak was 117 records held only in one process's RAM; all were rescued.

local_mcp: .mcp.json currently selects LOCAL mode (plain `server mcp`, needs $MNEM_MASTER_PASSWORD) since commit 32906cd
local_mcp_note: mcp/server.py was rewritten onto the official MCP SDK (mcp 2.2.0). It previously spoke a homemade {"tool":...,"args":...} line protocol that no MCP client could talk to, and returned {"status":"executed"} for any unimplemented tool - 22 of the advertised 33 were silent no-ops. Now 29 tools, all backed by real implementations, verified end-to-end with the official MCP client.
local_mcp_store_note: Two modes, and the choice matters because the stores differ: bridge mode (`server mcp --remote http://192.168.1.183:8000`) sees the container's 120 memories and needs no password; local mode opens /home/skynas/.memcore (124 memories, password-protected) and is what .mcp.json selects today, paired with scripts/sync-rest-to-local.py. Both open cleanly and answer everything, so a client pointed at the wrong one looks healthy while serving memories nobody wrote. Always know which store you are on.
count_note: Previously documented as 33 MCP tools and '200+' CLI commands. Real numbers are 29 and 60 (28 of the 60 are generated stubs that only print a placeholder). Do not restore the inflated figures.

The Dockerfile's `pip install -e ".[all]" || pip install -e .` hid the failure. Now one EMBEDDING_PROVIDER build arg, default 'local', and the build fails if the extras don't import.

blind_index_note: Worked for the first time on 2026-09-22. The tokenizer regex was written as '\b[a-z0-9]{3,}\b' in a non-raw string, so \b became a backspace (0x08) and nothing ever matched - every index written was empty. Live store reindexed: 120/120 rows carry a non-empty index. Reachable from the SDK/CLI (store.search_by_blind_index, `memcore system reindex-blind`), NOT over REST or MCP.
